meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 5 — Regional densification: Riyadh and Eastern Province (oil hub).

candidates.title: Riyadh region economic and administrative framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and regional sources
candidates.description: Framing of Riyadh as the capital and dominant administrative, services, finance and Vision 2030 project centre. Concentrates government, headquarters, and a large share of non-oil private-sector activity.

candidates.title: Eastern Province economic and oil framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from regional and energy sources
candidates.description: Framing of the Eastern Province as the principal oil and industrial hub. Hosts the bulk of crude production, refining, petrochemicals and a large share of FDI stock; low unemployment and high household incomes relative to other regions.
candidates.notes: Primary oil-province densification. Complements the national oil nodes.

candidates.title: Regional economic structure framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and spatial sources
candidates.description: System-level view of Saudi Arabia’s regional structure: Riyadh as administrative/services core, Eastern Province as oil/industrial core, and secondary poles (Makkah, Madinah, etc.). Continuously cited in Vision 2030 spatial and investment analysis.
candidates.notes: Spatial densification frame for the dual capital–oil structure.

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia regional densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from regional and spatial sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Riyadh, Eastern Province and regional-structure framing into a coherent provincial densification layer that complements the oil–Vision 2030 cores.
